description: Search the current promotions at Belgian retailers by product, brand or store, with optional filters. Returns the best matches (biggest per-item discount first unless sorted otherwise), each with price, discount, validity and a link to open it.

category.description: Category slug or name: voeding, drank, verzorging, huishouden, baby, dier, elektronica, huis-tuin, mode, speelgoed, sport.

ends_within_days.description: Only promotions that end within this many days.

max_price.description: Maximum price per item in euro.

min_discount.description: Minimum discount per item, in percent.

offset.description: Skip this many results (for the next page).

query.description: Words from the product, brand or kind of promotion, e.g. 'koffiecapsules', 'Philips', '1+1 gratis'. Optional.

sort.description: Default: relevance when there is a query, else discount.

store.description: Store name or slug, e.g. 'bol', 'Colruyt', 'albertheijn'. See list_stores. Optional.

name: search_deals
